app.title: Postal kit · residence permit
shell.limiti: What this tool does not do
home.h1: Let's prepare the postal kit, one step at a time
home.intro: This tool guides you through filling in the postal kit for your first residence permit: the forms to fill in, the documents to attach, the date by which to send it.
home.cta: I have received the postal kit
fonte.label: Source:
campo.nonCapisco: I do not understand this question
explain.istruzioneUfficiale: What the form says, word for word
explain.traduzione: The same sentence in simple English
nota.r: indicare nome e cognome, oppure la denominazione sociale di società/ente/associazione, presso cui si vuole che venga alternativamente recapitata la raccomandata per la convocazione in Questura
nota.r.traduzione: Write the name of who receives the post for you: a person, or a company, a body, an association. The Questura sends the registered letter that calls you in to that name.
nota.q: Se uguale al precedente non compilare
nota.q.traduzione: Note (q) applies to the whole of section 8, «Recapito per eventuali comunicazioni» (contact address for correspondence): if the address is the same as the previous one, the section is not filled in.
campo.77.plain: If the post does not come to you, in whose name does it come?
campo.77.why: The Questura sends the registered letter that tells you when to come to this name.
campo.77.example: Mariama Diallo Esempio. Or the name of an organisation: Associazione Esempio.
campo.77.explain.meaning: On the form this box is number 77 and is called «PRESSO» (C/O). It is inside section 8, «Recapito per eventuali comunicazioni» (contact address for correspondence). Here you write the name of the person, the company, the body or the association that receives the post for you, at the address in boxes 78-84. For section 8, note (q) says: «Se uguale al precedente non compilare» (if it is the same as the previous one, do not fill it in).
campo.77.explain.action: Write the first name and surname of the person, or the name of the organisation, that the Questura delivers the appointment letter to. If the address in this section is the same as the previous one, note (q) says not to fill in section 8.
modulo.4.h1: Where do you receive your post?
motivo.16: Employed work: you work for an employer
motivo.31: Study: you are enrolled at a school or a university
motivo.13: Family: you are joining or staying with a family member
percorso.intro.h1: Five questions, then we tell you where and by when
percorso.intro.testo: We ask you five questions, one per screen. With your answers we tell you whether the application is submitted at the post office or at the Questura, and the date by which to send it.
percorso.badge.locale: Your answers stay on this phone: we do not send them to anyone and nobody reads them.
percorso.progresso.label: Progress through the questions
percorso.1.why: The form asks for a code, not a sentence: your answer here becomes the number you write in box 16.
percorso.1.codice: Your code is {codice}. On the form, in box 16, write {codice}. In attached table no. 2 this reason is called:
percorso.1.nessunCodice: For this reason we have no code to give you: on the «Where you apply» screen we tell you who to ask.
percorso.2.why: Who brings the application to the counter changes the place where it is submitted.
percorso.2.terzo: A lawyer or a guardian, for me
percorso.2.terzo.nota: This also applies to a support administrator (amministratore di sostegno).
percorso.2.minore: I am a minor and I am not accompanied by a parent
percorso.2.minore.nota: You are between 14 and 18 years old and you are not with a parent.
percorso.3.label: The date you entered Italy
percorso.3.why: The count of the days you have to send the kit starts from this date.
percorso.3.formato: It is the date of the stamp in your passport. Example: 18 September 2026.
percorso.4.domanda: Which province are you staying in?
percorso.4.label: The province where you are staying
percorso.4.why: The Questura that receives your application is the one of the province where you are staying.
percorso.4.limite: For now the list has five provinces: this is a limit of this tool, not of the postal kit.
percorso.5.why: The answer decides whether you also fill in Form 2, the one with 68 boxes: it is filled in only if you have an income.
percorso.5.no: No, I do not have an income
percorso.5.no.nota: Form 2 does not concern you: we do not show it to you.
percorso.bloccato: Before you continue, correct the date: the error is written above.
percorso.passoInesistente.testo: The path has five questions, numbered 1 to 5. The answers you have already given are safe.
campo.48.explain.meaning: On the form this box is number 48 and it asks for the day you entered Italy: it is the date of the stamp the border police put in your passport. From that day the law counts the time you have to submit the application.
campo.48.explain.action: Open your passport, look for the most recent entry stamp and copy that date here. If the stamp cannot be read, take the passport with you to the counter and ask a patronato (a free advice office) for help.
issue.ENTRY_DATE_FUTURE.noticed: The date you wrote is in the future.
issue.ENTRY_DATE_FUTURE.why: Box 48 asks for the day you have already entered Italy: the days cannot be counted from a future date.
issue.ENTRY_DATE_FUTURE.what: Write the date of the entry stamp in your passport. If you have not entered Italy yet, this tool is for you after you arrive.
issue.ENTRY_DATE_TOO_OLD.noticed: You entered Italy more than 90 days ago.
issue.ENTRY_DATE_TOO_OLD.why: The deadline to submit the first application is 8 working days from entry: in your case it has passed, and the postal kit alone does not solve the situation.
issue.ENTRY_DATE_TOO_OLD.what: You can carry on: the next screens are still useful. Take your passport and your documents to a patronato, or call the Poste Italiane freephone number 800.200.309, and explain when you entered.
issue.DEADLINE_PASSED.noticed: The deadline to send the kit has passed.
issue.DEADLINE_PASSED.why: More days have passed since the date you wrote than article 5 paragraph 2 of legislative decree 286/1998 allows.
issue.DEADLINE_PASSED.what: You can carry on preparing the forms. Before you send them, get help from a patronato: a late application can be refused and they know what is done in these cases.
scadenza.banner.label: By when to send it
scadenza.stato.oggi: Today is the last day to send it.
scadenza.stato.domani: Tomorrow is the last day to send it.
dove.caricamento: We are reading your answers again.
dove.mancano: To tell you where the application is submitted we need the first two answers: the reason you are in Italy and who submits the application.
dove.vaiAllaScadenza: See by when to send it
dove.esito.ufficio-postale.testo: You can use the postal kit: your application is submitted at a post office.
dove.esito.questura.testo: This application is submitted at the Questura, the police headquarters, not at the post office.
dove.esito.dichiarazione-di-presenza.tes: For a stay of up to three months you do not ask for a residence permit: you make a declaration of presence.
dove.ragione.MOTIVO_SOLO_QUESTURA: For this reason the application is submitted only at the Questura.
dove.ragione.PRESENTATO_DA_TERZO: Lawyers, guardians and support administrators submit the application at the Questura, not at the post office counter.
dove.ragione.MINORE_NON_ACCOMPAGNATO: A minor between 14 and 18 years old who is not accompanied by a parent submits the application at the Questura.
dove.ragione.SOGGIORNO_BREVE: Up to three months you make a declaration of presence, not an application for a residence permit.
dove.ragione.MOTIVO_NON_RICONOSCIUTO: For the reason you chose, this tool cannot tell you where the application is submitted.
dove.sportello.titolo: Where you hand in the kit
dove.sportello.testo: The completed kit is handed in at the counter of an authorised post office, called Sportello Amico.
dove.sportello.documenti: The list of documents to put in the envelope comes on the documents screen: here the point is where you hand it in.
dove.limite.titolo: This is where this tool stops
dove.limite.testo: It is not your mistake: it is a declared limit of this tool. We cover employed work, study and family; for the other reasons we do not give you an answer we cannot verify.
dove.limite.doveChiedere: Ask a patronato, or call the Poste Italiane freephone number 800.200.309.
scadenza.h1: By when to send the kit
scadenza.mancaIngresso: To calculate the date we need the day you entered Italy.
scadenza.conteggio.dalGiornoDopo: You entered Italy on {ingresso}. The day of entry does not count: the count starts the next day and takes 8 working days.
scadenza.conteggio.limite: The count skips Saturdays, Sundays and national public holidays. The patron saint holidays of your municipality are not in the list.
scadenza.motivo.festivitaSenzaNome: it is a national public holiday
scadenza.prudente.titolo: There is also a second date
scadenza.prudente.perche: The sources do not use the same words: the Portale Immigrazione and the Polizia di Stato write «8 giorni lavorativi» (8 working days), Poste Italiane writes «8 giorni» (8 days). This is why there are two dates.
scadenza.prudente.qualeSceglie: The date at 8 calendar days comes first: sending by that date respects both readings. The tool does not choose for you, it shows you the two dates and where they come from.
scadenza.oltre.testo: An application submitted after the deadline can be refused. If you realise the deadline has passed, take your passport and documents to a patronato and explain your situation.
doc.link.daScadenza: See what to bring to the Sportello Amico
fee.h1: How much you pay, and where
fee.intro: There are four items to pay and they are paid in three different places. Here you find one item per row, with the amount and the place where it is paid. The totals are under the items: you can do the sum again by hand.
fee.durata.label: How long the permit you are asking for lasts
fee.durata.aiuto: The contribution changes with the length of the permit. Here we start from «up to 1 year».
fee.durata.conflitto.titolo: The sources do not say the same thing about the maximum length
fee.durata.conflitto.testo: The Polizia di Stato writes up to 3 years for open-ended employment; the Portale Immigrazione and the page on the procedure write 2 years. The length of your permit is decided by the Questura, not by this tool: the amount of the contribution is read from the length written on your permit.
fee.tabella.caption: The items you pay: amount, where it is paid, source
fee.dove.bollo: At a tobacconist or a shop that sells revenue stamps. You stick it on the application.
fee.dove.produzione: With the payment slip on current account 67422402, in the name of the Ministero dell'Economia e delle Finanze.
fee.dove.contributo: On the same payment slip: it is added to the production, it is not a second payment.
fee.dove.spedizione: To the clerk at the counter, when the application is accepted.
fee.bollettino.spiega: One payment slip per applicant: it adds up the production of the permit and the contribution.
fee.bollettino.causale: Reason to write on the payment slip: «importo per il rilascio del permesso di soggiorno elettronico» (amount for the issue of the electronic residence permit).
fee.bollettino.dove: The pre-filled payment slip is collected at the post offices authorised to receive applications.
fee.cassa.spiega: How much you pay in all, through three different channels: tobacconist, post office, counter.
fee.ricevute.titolo: The payment slip leaves you two receipts
fee.ricevute.testo: One receipt goes in the envelope with the kit, the other one you bring to the Questura on the day of the fingerprints. If you put both of them in the envelope, on the day of the appointment you have no proof of payment.
fee.esenzioni.titolo: Who does not pay the contribution
fee.esenzioni.intro: The contribution is not due in these cases:
fee.esenzioni.asilo: asylum, subsidiary protection and special protection
fee.esenzioni.cure: medical treatment, and those who accompany the person being treated
fee.esenzioni.permessoValido: update, conversion or copy of a permit that is still valid
fee.esenzione.MINORE_18: You are under 18: the contribution is not due.
fee.esenzione.CONTRIBUTO_NON_PREVISTO: For an update, a conversion or a copy of a permit that is still valid the contribution is not required.
fee.vaiAiDocumenti: See what to put in the envelope
fee.indietro: Back to by when to send it
doc.h1: What you put in the envelope
doc.intro: This is the list of documents for the reason you chose. For each item you find the name in simple words, the name the office uses, what it looks like and where you find it.
doc.caricamento: We are reading your answers again.
doc.mancaMotivo: To tell you which documents are needed we need one answer from the questions: the reason you are in Italy.
doc.contatore.aiuto: The ticks stay on this phone: if you reload the page you find them again.
doc.banner.tipo.testo: The list comes from the document of one single Questura, and Questure follow different practices. The list that counts for you is the one of your Questura: the one on its website, or the one they tell you at the counter.
doc.banner.autocert.testo: In Italy many certificates can be replaced by a declaration you sign yourself. Not for foreign citizens: you ask the office that issues them for the certificates, and you put a copy in the envelope.
doc.indietro: Back to how much you pay
doc.bollo.semplice: The 16 euro revenue stamp you buy at a tobacconist
doc.bollo.comEfatto: A large paper stamp with a number and a date on it.
doc.bollo.dove: At a tobacconist or a shop that sells revenue stamps. It is stuck on the form, not photocopied.
doc.copia-passaporto.comEfatto: The pages with your details, the expiry date, the visa and the entry stamps: one A4 photocopy for each page.
doc.copia-passaporto.dove: You have the passport; you make the photocopy at a copy shop, at a tobacconist or at a library.
doc.copia-permesso.semplice: The photocopy of the residence permit you already have
doc.copia-permesso.comEfatto: The card, front and back, on one A4 sheet.
doc.copia-permesso.dove: You have it, together with your other documents.
doc.copia-permesso.condizione: Only if you already have a permit. For a first permit you do not have one, and this item does not concern you.
doc.copia-codice-fiscale.semplice: The photocopy of the tax code (codice fiscale)
doc.copia-codice-fiscale.comEfatto: The card with the sixteen-character code, front and back on one A4 sheet.
doc.copia-codice-fiscale.dove: It is issued by the Agenzia delle Entrate; it is often the health card.
doc.copia-codice-fiscale.condizione: Only if it has already been issued to you.
doc.certificazione-dimora.semplice: The proof of where you live now
doc.certificazione-dimora.comEfatto: A sheet with a stamp: the certificate of residence from the Comune, or the declaration of hospitality from the person who hosts you, or the stamped cessione di fabbricato (notice of property handover).
doc.certificazione-dimora.dove: You ask for the certificate of residence at the registry office (anagrafe) of the Comune where you live; the declaration of hospitality is signed by the person who hosts you.
doc.certificazione-dimora.explain.meanin: «Dimora» is the place where you really live now, even if you are not registered there yet. It is needed because the Questura's letter arrives there.
doc.certificazione-dimora.explain.offici: certificazione dell'attuale dimora: certificato di residenza oppure dichiarazione di ospitalità o cessione di fabbricato vidimata
The proof of the address where you live today: the certificate of residence from the Comune, or the declaration of hospitality, or the notice of property handover with the stamp.
doc.certificazione-dimora.explain.action: If you are registered as a resident, ask for the certificate at the registry office of the Comune: you cannot replace it with a declaration of your own. If you are staying with someone, the person who hosts you writes the declaration of hospitality and reports it within 48 hours to the local public security authority: the police station (commissariato), the Questura, or the Comune where there is no police station.
doc.contratto-di-soggiorno.semplice: The contract you signed with your employer at the Sportello Unico
doc.contratto-di-soggiorno.comEfatto: A sheet with the stamp of the Sportello Unico per l'immigrazione and two signatures: yours and your employer's.
doc.contratto-di-soggiorno.dove: The Sportello Unico at the Prefettura gave it to you on the day you signed it.
doc.contratto-di-soggiorno.condizione: It is needed for the first issue of a work permit. It is not asked for again at renewal.
doc.modello-unilav.semplice: The notice your employer sent to the State when you were hired
doc.modello-unilav.comEfatto: A sheet printed from the labour website, with a protocol number and the date you were hired.
doc.modello-unilav.dove: Your employer gives it to you, or the consultant who handles the payslips.
doc.dichiarazione-redditi.semplice: The document that says how much you earned
doc.dichiarazione-redditi.comEfatto: The tax return (Modello 730 or Modello Redditi), or the Certificazione Unica that your employer gives you.
doc.dichiarazione-redditi.dove: Your employer gives you the Certificazione Unica; you find the tax return at the CAF or at the patronato that filled it in for you.
doc.dichiarazione-redditi.condizione: If you started working this year, the tax return does not exist yet: the last payslip counts instead of it.
doc.ultima-busta-paga.comEfatto: A sheet for the last month with your name, the days worked and the amount paid.
doc.ultima-busta-paga.dove: Your employer gives it to you, on paper or by email.
doc.ultima-busta-paga.condizione: It is needed if you were hired during the current year and do not have a tax return yet.
doc.accordo.testo: If your permit lasts at least one year, at the Sportello Unico you also sign the integration agreement (Accordo di integrazione): you undertake to learn Italian and to know the rules of civic life, and you start with credits. It is not a document to put in the envelope: it is signed later, at the Sportello Unico.
modulo.salto: For now this tool shows two screens of Form 1: the name and the contact address. The others come later.
nota.a: Riportare il dato come scritto sul passaporto o documento equipollente
nota.a.traduzione: Copy the detail exactly as it is written in the passport: the same letters, in the same order. This also applies when the surname comes before the first name in the passport.
modulo.1.h1: Your name, as it is written in your passport
modulo.1.intro: Two boxes for one single thing: your name. The form wants it in the order and with the letters of the passport, not in the order you use when you introduce yourself.
modulo.1.mrz.titolo: The bottom line of the passport
modulo.1.mrz.spiega: At the bottom of the page with the photo there are two lines of capital letters and «<» symbols. There the surname comes before the first name, and the two «<<» symbols separate one from the other.
modulo.1.mrz.leggenda.stato: type of document and code of the State that issued it
modulo.1.mrz.leggenda.separatore: separates the surname from the first name
modulo.1.mrz.finto: This passport does not exist: the letters in the example are invented.
modulo.1.mrz.label: If you want, copy the bottom line of your passport here
modulo.1.mrz.why: We check that the surname and the first name are in the right boxes. The field is optional: if you leave it empty the page works the same and we tell you nothing.
modulo.1.avanti: Continue: where you receive your post
campo.3.plain: How is your surname written *in your passport*?
campo.3.why: If you write something different here from what is in the passport, the Questura asks for an addition and the file stops.
campo.3.example: COGNOMEDIPROVA, the same letters as in the bottom line of the passport.
campo.3.explain.meaning: On the form this box is number 3 and is called «COGNOME» (SURNAME): it is the family name. In the bottom line of the passport the surname comes first, before the two «<<» symbols.
campo.3.explain.action: Open the passport at the page with the photo and copy the surname here letter by letter, as you find it written. If the surname comes before the first name in the passport, the surname still goes here.
campo.4.plain: How is your first name written *in your passport*?
campo.4.why: If the first name and the surname end up in swapped boxes, the Questura asks for an addition and the file stops.
campo.4.example: NOMEDIPROVA, what comes after the two «<<» symbols in the bottom line of the passport.
campo.4.explain.meaning: On the form this box is number 4 and is called «NOME» (NAME): it is the name you were given at birth. In the bottom line of the passport it comes after the surname, after the two «<<» symbols.
campo.4.explain.action: Copy the first name here as it is written in the passport. If there are two names in the passport, write both of them.
issue.NAME_ORDER_SUSPECT.noticed: In the passport line the surname and the first name look swapped between the two boxes.
issue.NAME_ORDER_SUSPECT.why: The form wants the details exactly as in the passport, and in the bottom line the surname comes before the first name.
issue.NAME_ORDER_SUSPECT.what: Check the passport: if they are swapped, swap them here too. If the passport really says this, leave it as it is and continue.
issue.NAME_NOT_IN_MRZ.noticed: What you wrote does not appear in the passport line you gave us.
issue.NAME_NOT_IN_MRZ.why: The form wants the detail as in the passport: if the letters do not match, the Questura asks for an addition.
issue.NAME_NOT_IN_MRZ.what: Read the bottom line of the passport again and check the two boxes. If you copied the line wrong, correct it or delete it: the field is optional.
issue.NAME_NON_LATIN.noticed: You used letters that are not from the Latin alphabet.
issue.NAME_NON_LATIN.why: In the passport the name is also written with the letters from A to Z, and that is the version the form wants.
issue.NAME_NON_LATIN.what: Copy the name from the page with the photo, from the line written with the letters from A to Z.
modulo.4.perche: This is where the Questura sends you the registered letter that tells you when to go for the photo and the fingerprints.
modulo.4.perche.seconda: If the registered letter does not arrive, your file stops and nobody tells you.
modulo.4.sezione8.titolo: What this part is called on the form
modulo.4.sezione8.nonCompilabile: Box 76 is the title of the section: nothing is written inside it. The boxes to fill in go from 77 to 84.
modulo.4.scelta.label: Where do you want to receive the registered letter?
modulo.4.scelta.stesso: I receive my post at the address where I live
modulo.4.scelta.stesso.nota: Section 8 stays empty: note (q) of the form says so.
modulo.4.scelta.altro: I receive my post at another address
modulo.4.scelta.altro.nota: For example at someone's home, or at your employer's: you fill in boxes 77 to 84.
modulo.4.capConfermato: You have confirmed the postcode: you can continue.
modulo.4.hoControllato: I have checked, it is correct
modulo.4.ancheModulo2: You answered that you have an income: after Form 1 you also fill in Form 2.
campo.68.plain: What is the address where you live in Italy?
campo.68.why: It is the address in section 7 of the form. If you receive your post there, section 8 stays empty.
campo.68.example: Via di Prova 0: street and number, as on the doorbell.
campo.68.explain.meaning: On the form this box is number 68 and it is in section 7, «Recapito in Italia del richiedente» (applicant's contact details in Italy), which goes from box 65 to box 72. Here this tool asks you only for the street and the number.
campo.68.explain.action: Write the street and the number of the place where you live now, even if you are not registered there yet. On the paper form you fill in the whole of section 7.
nota.78.traduzione: You do not invent the province code: you copy it from attached table no. 1 of the form, the one titled «Province». For Modena it is MO.
campo.78.plain: In which province do you receive your post?
campo.78.why: The province and the postcode must say the same place, otherwise the registered letter goes around.
campo.78.example: Modena (MO). For now the list has five provinces: this is a limit of this tool, not of the form.
campo.78.explain.meaning: On the form this box is number 78 and it wants the two-letter code of the province, for example MO for Modena.
campo.78.explain.action: Choose from the list the province of the address where you receive your post. On the paper form you write the two-letter code.
campo.79.plain: In which municipality do you receive your post?
campo.79.why: It is the town or the village written on the envelope.
campo.79.explain.meaning: On the form this box is number 79: the comune, that is the town or the village of the address where you receive your post.
campo.79.explain.action: Write the name of the comune as it appears on the envelopes you receive.
campo.80.plain: What is the street where you receive your post?
campo.80.why: It is the street line of the address: via, viale, piazza or strada.
campo.80.explain.meaning: On the form this box is number 80: the street, without the house number, which goes in box 81.
campo.80.explain.action: Write only the name of the street. You write the number in the next box.
campo.81.why: Without the number, the person who delivers the post does not find the door.
campo.81.explain.meaning: On the form this box is number 81: the house number, that is the number of the house. It can also contain a letter.
campo.81.explain.action: Copy the number from the doorbell or from the letterbox.
campo.82.plain: Is there a staircase? If there is not, leave it empty
campo.82.why: In large buildings the staircase tells the person who delivers the post which door to enter.
campo.82.example: A. If your house has no staircase, leave it empty.
campo.82.explain.meaning: On the form this box is number 82. The staircase is the letter or the number that tells apart the different entrances of a large building.
campo.82.explain.action: If there is a staircase on the entryphone, write it here. Otherwise leave the box empty: it is not a mistake.
campo.83.plain: Is there an apartment number? If there is not, leave it empty
campo.83.why: The apartment number is the number of the flat inside the building.
campo.83.example: 0. If you live in a single house, leave it empty.
campo.83.explain.meaning: On the form this box is number 83. The apartment number is the number of the flat: you find it on the doorbell, often after the word «int.».
campo.83.explain.action: Write the number of the flat. If there is none, leave the box empty: it is not a mistake.
campo.84.plain: What is the postcode of the address where you receive your post?
campo.84.why: The postcode tells the post office which area to deliver to: it is five digits.
campo.84.example: 41000: five digits, and if the first one is a zero you write it.
campo.84.explain.meaning: On the form this box is number 84. The CAP is the postcode: five digits that say the delivery area. You find it on the envelopes you receive.
campo.84.explain.action: Write the five digits of the postcode of the address in this section, not of the place where you are registered.
issue.ADDRESS_EMPTY_NO_STABLE.noticed: We have no address: section 7 is empty and you are not filling in section 8.
issue.ADDRESS_EMPTY_NO_STABLE.why: The Questura sends the registered appointment letter to an address written on the form: with no address, the letter does not leave.
issue.ADDRESS_EMPTY_NO_STABLE.what: Write the address where you live in box 68, or choose «I receive my post at another address» and fill in boxes 77 to 84.
issue.ADDRESS_SAME_AS_RESIDENCE.noticed: The address in section 8 is the same as the one in section 7.
issue.ADDRESS_SAME_AS_RESIDENCE.why: For section 8, note (q) of the form says: «Se uguale al precedente non compilare» (if it is the same as the previous one, do not fill it in).
issue.ADDRESS_SAME_AS_RESIDENCE.what: You can choose «I receive my post at the address where I live» and leave section 8 empty.
issue.ADDRESS_PROVINCE_MISMATCH.noticed: The postcode you wrote is not from the province you chose.
issue.ADDRESS_PROVINCE_MISMATCH.why: The Questura sends the appointment letter to the address in this section.
issue.ADDRESS_PROVINCE_MISMATCH.what: If you receive your post in another province this is fine: press «I have checked, it is correct». Otherwise correct the postcode.

riepilogo.dopo.dove.testo: At a post office with a Sportello Amico: not all offices have one, check before you go.
riepilogo.dopo.dove.diPersona: You go yourself, in person: the application is submitted by the person concerned.
riepilogo.dopo.ricevi.ricevuta: A receipt with two codes: the Codice Assicurata and the Codice Ologramma. They are the codes to check online how the file is going.
riepilogo.dopo.ricevi.convocazione: An appointment letter with the date, the time and the place of the appointment at the Questura.
riepilogo.dopo.ricevi.agendaPiena: If the diary of the Questura is full, the appointment arrives later, by registered letter, at the address in section 8: this is why that address matters.
riepilogo.dopo.conserva.testo: Keep the receipt together with your passport.
riepilogo.dopo.conserva.valore: A person who shows the receipt of the first issue for employed work, self-employed work or family reunification has the same rights that come with holding the residence permit; while waiting for the first work permit you can work, unless you are told there are reasons that prevent it.
riepilogo.dopo.porta.titolo: What to bring to the appointment
riepilogo.dopo.porta.intro: Tick each thing the evening before.
riepilogo.porta.foto: 4 passport-size photographs, white background, 35 × 45 mm: they are needed at the Questura, not at the post office. A person who does not have them gets a new appointment.
riepilogo.porta.ricevuta: The receipt of the insured letter.
riepilogo.porta.appuntamento: The appointment given by the post office.
riepilogo.porta.bollettino: The second receipt of the payment slip.
riepilogo.porta.originali: The originals of all the documents you attached as photocopies.
riepilogo.porta.figli: If children under 14 are included in the permit: 4 photos for each of them, and the children present.
riepilogo.dopo.tempi.testo: On average, the file is processed in 60 days from the date it is submitted.
riepilogo.dopo.tempi.nonPromessa: This is the information the official sources give, not a promise about your Questura.
riepilogo.dopo.stato.testo: With the two codes on the receipt, on the Portale Immigrazione; after the appointment, on the Polizia di Stato website.
riepilogo.dopo.stato.numeroVerde: The exact address of the private area is not published and we do not invent one: you can call the Poste freephone number 800.200.309, Monday to Saturday except public holidays, from 8:00 to 20:00.

riepilogo.limiti.link: What this tool does not do
issue.SIGNATURE_REQUIRED.noticed: You have not ticked «I have signed» yet.
issue.SIGNATURE_REQUIRED.why: Without the signature in box 29 the application is not accepted at the post office counter.
issue.SIGNATURE_REQUIRED.what: Sign the paper form in box 29, then tick the box above.
issue.SHEET_COUNT_UNCONFIRMED.noticed: The number of sheets in box 25 is still our proposal.
issue.SHEET_COUNT_UNCONFIRMED.why: That number goes on a form that you sign: we do not write it for you.
issue.SHEET_COUNT_UNCONFIRMED.what: Count the sheets you put in the envelope, write the number in box 25 and tick the confirmation.
issue.PASSPORT_NUMBER_EMPTY.why: Box 44 of the form asks for the passport number: without it, the application is incomplete.
issue.PASSPORT_NUMBER_EMPTY.what: Copy the number from the passport into box 44 of the paper form: this tool does not have the screen for that field yet.
issue.PASSPORT_EXPIRED_BEFORE_ENTRY.noti: The expiry date of the passport is before the entry date you wrote.
issue.PASSPORT_EXPIRED_BEFORE_ENTRY.why: A passport that expired before entry cannot be the one you entered with: one of the two dates is wrong.
issue.PASSPORT_EXPIRED_BEFORE_ENTRY.what: Check the expiry date in the passport (box 45) and the entry date (box 48), and correct the wrong one.
limiti.h1: What this tool does not do
limiti.intro: This tool guides you through filling in the postal kit for the first residence permit. Here it is written where it stops helping you: read it before you trust what it shows you.
limiti.nonFacciamo.consulenza: This is not legal advice. We explain a procedure, we do not give advice: we do not tell you what to choose.
limiti.nonFacciamo.invio: We do not send anything: not to the Questura, not to Poste, not to the Portale Immigrazione. You submit the application yourself, in person, at the post office counter.
limiti.nonFacciamo.stato: We do not know how your file is going. Your answers stay on this device and we are not connected to any office.
limiti.nonFacciamo.esito: We do not predict the outcome or the times of your Questura. The 60 days you read are an average stated by the Polizia di Stato, not a promise.
limiti.nonFacciamo.valutazioni: We do not choose the type of permit for you in doubtful cases and we do not assess whether your income is enough: these are assessments made by the Questura.
limiti.nonFacciamo.campi: We do not fill in the fields that depend on a document you do not have yet: contratto di soggiorno, nulla osta, idoneità alloggiativa.
limiti.gratuito.titolo: There is a free way, with a person in front of you
limiti.gratuito.testo: Patronati and authorised Comuni fill in the application from a dedicated portal and give you the paper copy to put in the envelope: the help is free.
limiti.gratuito.numeroVerde: The Poste freephone number 800.200.309 answers Monday to Saturday except public holidays, from 8:00 to 20:00, also about the progress of the file.
limiti.gratuito.scelta: If you prefer a person, go to a patronato. This tool is for a person who wants to understand before going there, or who has no patronato nearby.
limiti.semplificato.titolo: What we simplified, and what we did not change
limiti.semplificato.parole: The words are ours, the content is from the official sources. We did not copy the text of the Ministry and we did not write it from memory.
limiti.semplificato.nomeUfficiale: The bureaucratic name is always there, next to the explanation: it is the one you look for on your documents and the one the clerk at the counter recognises.
limiti.semplificato.numeri: We did not touch any number: amounts, deadlines, photograph sizes, the current account number are the ones from the sources, digit by digit.
limiti.semplificato.registro: Every simplification that is not obvious is recorded with the original text next to it, in the project file docs/evidence/meaning-checks.md.
limiti.nonSappiamo.titolo: What we do not know, and we write it down
limiti.nonSappiamo.patronali: Local patron saint holidays do not enter the count of working days: we count only the national ones. If your province celebrates its patron saint inside your 8 days, you have one day less than we tell you. If in doubt, go earlier.
limiti.nonSappiamo.checklist: The list of documents is a sample list. Questure vary in their practice and our source is the document of one single Questura: the list that counts for you is the one of yours.
limiti.nonSappiamo.dueDate: The two deadline dates. The official sources do not agree: the Polizia di Stato and the Portale Immigrazione say 8 working days, Poste says 8 days. We show you both of them and we tell you which one is the more cautious.
limiti.nonSappiamo.copertura: We cover the first issue for employed work, study and family, and only the postal kit. We do not cover renewal, update, conversion, copy; reasons other than these are submitted at the Questura, not at the post office.
limiti.nonSappiamo.lingue: The interface is written in Italian, French and English. Spanish is prepared but not translated yet: if you choose it, you see empty sentences instead of the texts. Arabic is not there: the writing direction needs work that did not fit in the time we had.
limiti.nonVerificati.titolo: Two pieces of information we could not verify against an official source
limiti.nonVerificati.intro: Everything else in this tool cites the source it comes from. Two numbers do not: we found no official document to cite, and we kept them anyway, because without them the tool is of no use to you. Here they are, with what happens if they are wrong.
limiti.nonVerificati.cap: The postcode ranges for each province. They only serve to tell you «careful, this postcode and this province do not look like the same place». If a range is wrong, we warn you when there is no need, or we stay silent when a warning would help: either way the decision stays yours and no field is blocked. The right postcode is the one written on the letters you receive.
limiti.nonVerificati.fogli: The number of sheets in Form 1 and Form 2, used to propose the total for box 25. We counted them ourselves. If they are wrong, the proposed total is wrong: that is why the number stays a proposal and you have to tick the confirmation before writing it on the form. Count the sheets you actually put in the envelope.
limiti.nonVerificati.tuttoIlResto: Neither of the two is marked on screen: this page is where we tell you.
limiti.ai.nessuna: No artificial intelligence runs inside this tool. No model answers your questions, no text is generated while you use it.
limiti.ai.funzioni: The rules are functions written and checked with automated tests: the count of the days, the checks on the address, the sum of the amounts.
limiti.ai.perche: A function that counts working days always gives the same answer. A model gives a probable answer, and on a legal deadline that difference is everything.
limiti.ai.costruzione: We used artificial intelligence to build this tool: where, is written in the project file docs/ai-contributions.md.
limiti.fonti.intro: Every number and every list you see carries its source next to it. These are the sources we come from; the full list, with the date we checked it, is in the project file docs/sources.md.
limiti.fonti.avviso: If what you read here is different from what the office says, what the office says counts.
